result:
All 15 defects in linear_functions are fixed in commit `c7e62a3` on `v2/t-bank-fix-linear_functions`, made from `v2/t-bank-all`. Nothing is pushed or merged. Each change touches only what grid-in items name as mistakes; the multiple-choice lists are unchanged. All four checks pass. **Changes (all under `satbank/topics/linear_functions/families/`):** | # | File, function | What changed | |---|---|---| | 1, 8 | `graph.py` `graph_read` (value ask) | The vertical-axis reason now names the value where the drawn axis is, m·x0 + b, not b. The x/key reason is dropped. The existing half-gridline filter still applies. | | 2 | `context.py` `context_two_points` | "One/two units too far" now steps away from the nearer point: raw + s·m and raw + 2s·m, where s = sign(x3 − nearer x). If x3 is the same distance from both points, neither step reason is named. | | 3–5, 9, 14 | `basic.py` `_eval_mistakes` | New `spr=False` flag, used only by the grid-in branch. With it on:
• the quotient add-slip keeps c: (a + x0 + c)/d
• "dropped the negative sign" is named only when key < 0
• the sign-of-input reason is skipped at x0 = 0
• x0·b is named only when m == 1
• side by side is named only when m == 1, b > 0 and x0 > 0
• "subtracted/added the constant" follows the sign of b or c | | 9, 11 | `basic.py` `inner_scale` | The verb follows the sign of d in both asks. (value − d)/k now reads "inverted the ratio after removing the constant". | | 12 | `basic.py` `combine` | (p − q)/(2d) now reads "added the denominators when subtracting the fractions". | | 6, 10 | `symbolic.py` `affine_conversion` | For the change ask, "substituted the change into the whole formula" now names F(Δ) = (9/5)(Δ − s) + 32. The value that also drops the + 32 is removed, since no single slip produces it. The inverse reason now reads "added the constant term instead of subtracting it". | | 13 | `define.py` `table_facts` | When b ≥ 0 the reason reads "gave b instead of a − b". | | 7, 9, 15 | `context.py` `model_value` | Rounded contexts round slips half up. When m < 0 the reason reads "added the change instead of subtracting it". The two inverse division reasons name the exact total/m and b/m. A student who types 75.81 or 75.82 still matches 834/11, because typed answers are compared the SAT way. | One change was not in the list: I also dropped "added the coefficient to the constant, ignoring its sign" when b > 0. There is no sign to ignore then, which is the same flaw as defect 13. At seed 37 the value 216 was about to be named under that reason once the sign-of-input reason was removed. **Checks.** Every item was generated for seeds 0–4999 in three modes (default, forced grid-in, forced multiple-choice) from master, from `v2/t-bank-all` and from the fix: 1. **Multiple-choice vs master:** 0 of 154,293 items differ. The same inputs fail to generate on master and on the fix. 2. **Grid-ins vs master:** 0 of 68,406 differ outside `spr_mistakes`. 3. **Reasons recomputed:** `verify.py` works out each reason's value from the item's own numbers (and the stem where they don't say it), written from the words rather than the template code. - On the fix, every named value in the eight changed templates matches, about 178,000 values with 0 mismatches. - On `v2/t-bank-all` the same script finds 11,821 wrong values in seeds 0–1499, so it does catch these defects. - The defect seeds come out as expected: - 487: 295 and 304 - 1282: 265 and 272 - 114: 22,171 and 21,849 - 4585: −1 - 887: −140 is gone - 651 and 2: 788 and 985 are gone - 246: −456.97 - 193: 41 - 228: 85 - 3483: 834/11 - 7: 11/5 at the axis - 122: "added the change" - 1466: "subtracted the constant" - 1525 and 1555: reworded - 2485: "gave b instead of a − b" - At seed 4912 the axis value 246 is now correct but is not named: it is within half a gridline of the key 325, so the existing filter drops it. 4. **Gate:** `PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m satbank check --topic linear_functions` prints `Linear Functions [linear_functions] PASS`.
